name: EYE R3 — HIDDEN MACHINE MINER

ru: ИЩИ ОДИНАКОВЫЕ МАШИНЫ, СПРЯТАННЫЕ ПОД РАЗНЫМИ СЛОВАМИ.
central_law.formal: WORDS(A,B) MAY APPROACH 0 WHILE MACHINE(A,B) APPROACHES 1
central_law.machine_definition: An ordered composition of epistemic operators that recurs across distant domains while preserving transition order and representation invariants.

target_invariant: ordered operator-machine structure rather than shared vocabulary
canonical_transform: DOCUMENTS -> OPERATOR EVENTS -> ORDERED OPERATOR WINDOWS -> HIDDEN MACHINES -> CROSS_DOMAIN CONSTELLATIONS -> VERIFY
target_diagnostic_rule: PALOMAR/MUSIC/GENESIS is measured because it motivated R3, but receives zero scoring bonus and may return NOT_FOUND.

representation_contract.metric: hidden-machine structural score with lexical, lineage, ubiquitous-operator and explicit-link penalties
representation_contract.positive_control: Known same-mechanism artifacts expressed with different vocabulary should recover a shared ordered operator machine.
representation_contract.negative_control: Lexically similar artifacts whose operator order differs should not receive a strong exact-machine score.
representation_contract.falsifier: After held-out/manual sequence verification and controls for boilerplate, lineage duplication, and ubiquitous JANUS operators, the proposed machine order fails to reproduce across the claimed domains.
representation_contract.multiplicity_rule: All mined machines remain candidates; ranking never promotes them to discovery.
representation_contract.open_rule: Return OPEN when independent support, order preservation, or provenance is insufficient.

seal: DO NOT MATCH THE WORDS. MATCH THE MACHINE, THEN TRY TO BREAK IT.
